text:
maria: ACME just came back: SSO + retention/audit logs are non-negotiable for their security team. They want SAML + 90d audit retention in launch build.

kevin: ack. quick engineering read: SAML handshake + metadata UI ~6 dev-days. Audit pipeline (ingest + retention) another 6-8 dev-days unless we reuse existing infra. Ops + infra review required for storage retention and encryption keys.

lee: compliance note: 90d retention with tamper evidence needs log signing or immutability flags on storage. That adds ops work and slightly higher infra cost. Also need a privacy review for tenant-level logs.

nisha: two possible scopes:
- MVP-lite: ship without SSO/audit, migrate ACME to pilot contract with limited sandbox access.
- MVP-plus: include minimal SAML SSO + basic append-only audit store, push launch by ~10 calendar days.

maria: timeline impact matters because of our trade show demo and sales cadence. If we slip, we risk losing momentum with 3 smaller customers.

kevin: can we fast-track by reassigning one infra engineer for 2 weeks to wire the retention policy? That would keep the slip to ~6 calendar days.

lee: if we reassign infra, we must freeze a couple low-priority infra spikes. Also need runbook for log access and key rotation.

nisha: gating criteria for MVP-plus (must pass all to go):
- SAML auth end-to-end test matrix green in staging.
- Audit store append-only verified and retention policy enforced.
- No performance regression beyond +5% 95th latency on inference routes.
- Ops runbook created and reviewed.

maria: +1 to the gates. Can we quantify expected ARR if ACME signs at launch? Sales estimate ~$60k ARR first year.

kevin: rough cost: 12 dev-days total across teams. If we value dev-day at $1.2k fully burdened, dev cost ~ $14.4k (one-time). Infra delta ~ $600/mo incremental. Numbers favor adding the feature if exec prioritizes.

lee: security checks: need a quick pen test scope (SSO + audit endpoints) — can we get a rapid internal review in 3 days?

nisha: decision proposal: if execs approve reassign (one infra + one backend) -> go MVP-plus. If not, ship MVP-lite and schedule SSO/audit for v1 with a clear pilot plan for ACME.

maria: sales prefers MVP-plus but will accept pilot path. They'll push ACME to accept pilot credits if we defer.

product-bot: ACME LOI link uploaded: https://acme.example/loi v1.1 — noted in deals board.

kevin: action items:
- @kevin: create exact task breakdown + blockers in ticket SSO-201 by EOD (1778000600).
- @lee: draft quick security checklist and pen test request by tomorrow.
- @nisha: write exec note with cost delta + recommendation by noon tomorrow.
- @maria: prep outreach messaging for ACME if we ask for pilot credit.

maria: I'll ping the execs after we have the task breakdown.

kevin: posted SSO-201 with ETA and task map: https://redwood.internal/boards/SSO-201 — shows 12 dev-days, can hit MVP-plus with reassign.

nisha: vote: +1 MVP-plus if reassign confirmed.

lee: +1 but require security signoff before release.

maria: marking a +1 conditional on reassign.

product-bot: Canary checklist stub created at https://redwood.internal/launchs/1778000000/canary-checklist :white_check_mark:. Execs notified.

maria: closing thread for now. reconvene in 24h or earlier if exec decision arrives. :calendar:
